EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install edgcpp-backends-suite. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_VERSION.description: Specific version of edgcpp-backends-suite to install.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading edgcpp-backends-suite binary or archive artifacts.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying edgcpp-backends-suite available remote releases.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_REPO.description: Pinned filesystem checkout of edgcpp-compiler-multibackend evaluated by E0-E7.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_PAPER_DIR.description: Manuscript directory containing edgecpp_backends.tex and scripts/render_tex_tables.py.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_RESULTS_DIR.description: Output directory receiving results/raw/*.json and generated_metrics.tex.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_SYNTHETIC.description: When true, executes deterministic synthetic fixture mode for fast offline CI and self-test verification.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_TRIALS.description: Number of timed benchmark iterations per compiler pipeline cell (after 1 untimed warmup run).

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_WARMUPS.description: Number of untimed warmup runs executed prior to recorded timed iterations.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of sub-suites to run (default 'E0,E1,E2,E3,E4,E5,E6,E7').

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_HOST_ARCH.description: Canonical host OS/ISA identifier recorded in benchmark outputs (e.g., macos_arm64, linux_x64, windows_x64).

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_BUILD_PDF.description: When set to '1', compiles edgecpp_backends.tex via texlive and verifies zero Overfull boxes and <= 20 main-text pages.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_CROSS_ISA_QEMU.description: When set to '1' on Linux, runs the optional 6-architecture Cross-ISA qemu-user-static psABI interop fuzz sweep in E5.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_ALLOW_DIRTY.description: Override flag ('1') allowing local development runs on uncommitted repositories without failing RULE-1.

EDGCPP_BACKENDS_SUITE_DRY_RUN.description: When set to '1', validates manifests and command routing without executing long compiler sweeps.
